Ingram Micro jumps after securing spot in S&P SmallCap 600
summary: Investing.com -- Ingram Micro Holding Ltd (NYSE:INGM) shares climbed 4.8% in extended trading Wednesday after S&P Dow Jones Indices announced the technology distributor will join the S&P SmallCap 600. The Irvine, California-based company is scheduled to enter the benchmark prior to the open of trading on Tuesday, November 17, replacing Pacira Pharmaceuticals Inc (NASDAQ:PCRX).

summary: Medication company Viatris (NASDAQ:VTRS) fell short of the market’s revenue expectations in Q3 2026, with sales flat year on year at $3.75 billion.
